entities.name: SVP1-like protein 2
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Candida glabrata Q6FXC1; 445 residues and 100% query/target coverage.
Predicted molecular weight is 50.43 kDa, theoretical pI 9.29, and charge at pH 7 is +12.5.
Sequence contains a PROPPIN domain (PF21032) at residues 109–299 and a WD40-related hit around residues 213–244.
Annotated as a peripheral membrane protein associated with vacuole, endosome, and cytoplasmic vesicle membranes.
Binds phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate, phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate, phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate, and phosphatidylinositol-5-phosphate.
In Saccharomyces cerevisiae, the ortholog participates in piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus and broader selective autophagy processes.
No explicit catalytic reaction, enzyme activity, or cofactor annotation was retrieved; the protein is best interpreted as a lipid-binding adaptor/scaffold rather than an enzyme.

entities.name: Piecemeal microautophagy
observations: SVP1-like protein 2 orthologs are involved in piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus and related selective autophagy pathways in yeast.
The protein is recruited to endosomal/vacuolar membranes through phosphoinositide binding.
